officialReleaseNotes: Build 254: original English-to-Italian Exercise Laboratory covering all 24 current authoring presets and their supported modes.
title: Exercise Laboratory
courseDescription: An English-to-Italian laboratory for trying every current Exercise type and its meaningful authoring options. Five Lessons group Select, Input, Arrange, Match and Presentation. Inspect or Fork the Course in Course Studio to study how the exercises are authored. Enable Audio Exercises and Text-to-speech to include all listening and pronunciation examples; ordinary lesson progression remains in effect.

mediaAttributions.author: QuisquisLingo
mediaAttributions.title: Exercise Laboratory printed-character specimens
mediaAttributions.source: Original deterministic block lettering generated by tools/generate_exercise_laboratory_254.py; no external font or image source.
mediaAttributions.appliesTo: Embedded A, E and È PNGs, including the blue E variant, in Recognize characters examples.

content.text: Choose an answer, select a complete set, or fill fixed gaps with reusable options. The Rounds also demonstrate images, characters, reading, dialogue, listening and both translation directions. Listening needs Enable Audio Exercises and Text-to-speech in Audio Settings; Preview ignores those learner switches.
Read the instruction carefully. Single-answer questions check immediately. Multiple-answer questions wait for Check; select every correct option and no distractor.

prompt.text: How do you say ‘thank you’ in Italian?
How do you say ‘the apple’ in Italian?
Which words are Italian colours? Select all correct answers.
Which words name an animal? Select all correct answers.
Which word means ‘yes’? Select the correct answer, then press Check.

content.text: In Fill in the blank, choose one missing expression. In the fixed-sentence exercises, fill each gap; an option can be used again. You can remove, move and swap answers before Check.

prompt.text: Complete both sentences. The same word can be used twice.

content.text: Match words to pictures, then inspect the printed characters. Character images are original portable PNG specimens. Image choices check immediately.

prompt.text: Select the character shown in both specimens.
Select the image of È (E with a grave accent).

content.text: Read the passage or conversation before choosing an answer. Contextual comprehension can use a passage, labelled speakers, or both.

prompt.text: Anna abita a Roma. Ogni mattina va al lavoro in autobus.
Un amico ti offre un bicchiere d'acqua.
Vuoi accettare. Qual è la risposta adatta?
La biblioteca apre alle nove e chiude alle diciotto.
A che ora apre la biblioteca?
Anna e Luca sono in cucina.

content.text: Enable Audio Exercises and Text-to-speech to practise every item here. Use the replay control as needed. Listen for meaning as well as for individual words.

prompt.text: Maria compra due mele e un chilo di pane al mercato.
Il treno per Roma parte dal binario tre.
Da quale binario parte il treno?
Luca legge un libro in giardino.
Luca legge un libro in giardino.
Anna e Luca parlano dopo pranzo.
Vuoi un caffè? Sì, senza zucchero.

content.text: Read the language named in the instruction. QQL supplies the instruction for each direction. Pronunciation is optional; these questions remain available with Audio Exercises off.

Type a translation, a missing fragment, a complete word, or a transcription. Accepted answers can include optional wording and alternatives. Accents are preserved; ordinary capitalization, punctuation and spacing are normalized. Only Type the translation and Type the missing word tolerate one omitted or duplicated repeated letter.
Type a natural Italian translation. These examples demonstrate several ways an author can record equivalent answers; the answer notation is never shown as the learner prompt.

prompt.text: The teacher is tired. (The teacher may be a man or a woman.)

content.text: Translate the complete sentence. Several natural word orders may be accepted. Keep accents and apostrophes, and check repeated letters when you type.

prompt.text: I am going to Rome tomorrow.
I study at home in the evening.
Today I buy bread and milk.

exercise.hint: Use the contracted definite article before acqua.

content.text: Type the missing text. Type the missing word gives the first letter as a hint and still expects the complete word. A phrase with pronunciation audio also accepts its complete spoken form.

exercise.hint: Think of a common household animal.
Both accepted animals begin with the same letter.

prompt.text: Il mio amico francese si chiama ___.

exercise.hint: Two traditional French male names are accepted.

content.text: Enable Audio Exercises and Text-to-speech. For a transcription, type the whole utterance. For missing words, complete the numbered fields in transcript order.

prompt.text: Type the sentence about the train.
Type the short statement about a feeling.
Luca legge un libro in giardino.
Luca legge un libro in giardino.

content.text: Build an Italian answer from words, phrases, letters or syllables. Ordinary Arrange consumes each block once; repeated words need repeated blocks. Inline Arrange fills fixed gaps with distinct blocks. Word order and Build the translation allow zero, one or two distractors; Image-prompt ordering allows none.
Tap blocks to build the answer. You can remove a chosen block before checking. Repeated words are separate occurrences.

prompt.text: Put the Italian sentence in order: The cat sleeps.
Put the Italian sentence in order: Anna drinks water.
Put the Italian sentence in order: The train leaves today.
Build: Anna eats bread and Luca eats rice.

correctOrders.text: Anna mangia pane e Luca mangia riso

prompt.text: Build: I go to school by bus.

content.text: Fill each gap using a separate block. Unlike Select, placing a block removes that occurrence from the available bank. Duplicate words need two blocks. Gap contents can be removed, moved or swapped.

prompt.text: Complete the sentence about Anna's drink.
Complete the sentences using separate blocks.
Io vado a scuola in autobus.

content.text: Translate the English prompt using the available literal blocks. Some questions accept more than one complete translation. Answer-expression notation and typo tolerance do not apply to this exercise type.

prompt.text: I go to school by train.
Anna drinks water and Luca drinks milk.

correctOrders.text: Anna beve acqua e Luca beve latte

content.text: Use every available block to write the Italian word for the picture. There are no distractors. Each repeated letter is a separate block.

prompt.text: Build the Italian word for this fruit.
Build the Italian word for this animal.
Build the Italian word for this fruit. Use the singular word.

content.text: Match each item on the left to its partner. The shuffled columns preserve stable pair identities. Match the pairs can use a variable number of text pairs; Match the words, Match related words and Listen and match use exactly three pairs. Listen and match needs audio enabled.
Match every row before Check. For related words, read whether the task asks for synonyms or opposites.

prompt.text: Match the Italian greeting with its English meaning.
Match each Italian phrase with its English meaning.
Match the English words with their Italian translations.
Abbina ogni parola al suo sinonimo.

content.text: Enable Audio Exercises and Text-to-speech. Play each sound and match it to the English meaning. Three sounds have three distinct partners and no distractors.

prompt.text: Listen and match each Italian word with its English meaning.

content.text: Match these familiar Italian words to their opposites.

prompt.text: Abbina ogni parola al suo contrario.

content.text: Flashcards present material without a scored answer. Got it completes a card; Review again schedules it again later in this Round. These six cards cover all meaningful combinations of optional pronunciation, usage and usage translation. A usage translation only appears with a usage sentence. Cards with pronunciation audio follow learner Audio Settings.
Read each card. Try Review again once, then Got it when the card returns. These cards can be studied without audio and do not earn correct-answer base XP.
Enable Audio Exercises and Text-to-speech to include these cards. Play the word or the usage sentence, then choose Got it or Review again.
I drink a glass of water.
